# Historical fixtures — retired product lines (do not re-track)

These page excerpts were retrieved on 2026-10-12 while earlier iterations were
tracking Lavazza Qualità Oro, Qualità Rossa and Suerte. The owner correction of
2026-10-12 retired those lines: the only tracked product is **Lavazza Crema e
Gusto vacuum-packed ground coffee**.

The files are kept **only as historical evidence and as negative test inputs**,
so a future change can prove that a retired line is refused instead of silently
re-entering the board. They are not vendor fetch targets, not part of
`tests/fixtures/vendor-fixtures.mjs`, and no adapter reads them at runtime.

Re-tracking a product line requires an explicit new owner instruction
(see AGENTS.md and docs/STATUS.md).
